finding.title: Read the authenticated login profile instead of an unfiltered profile query
finding.evidence: SDK get_profile(None) ignores self.profile, GETs /profiles with empty params, and returns first returned Profile. SDK __handle_authorization sets self.profile from login-response user.profile.id.
finding.impact: Current owner guard uses an unrelated profile enumeration result rather than authenticated identity; valid writes can be refused, and the guard lacks the intended identity binding. Readback also depends on the unnecessary profile query.
finding.fix: Use client.profile.id from successful authentication, require a valid profile ID, fail closed if missing; optionally cross-check client.user.profile.id. Add an actual-SDK unbound or semantically faithful principal test.

resolution.change: Authenticated identity now reads client.profile.id, rejects missing/malformed values, and no longer calls unfiltered get_profile(None). FakeClient.get_profile now raises to catch accidental reuse.
resolution.scope: Static re-review plus actual SDK unbound semantic proof; root owns current full regression/live-gate/dry-run verification. No auth or writes executed.
